verdict.rationale: Gide documents a dedicated Intellectual Property practice that explicitly covers trademarks. It claims in-depth expertise in trade mark disputes before French and EU courts and offices, plus cross-border trademark litigation, so the brand-enforcement part is well evidenced. Clearance searches and registration/prosecution work are not documented, and trademarks sit inside the broader IP team rather than a distinct trademark team. Missing for 10: documented trademark clearance/availability searches, documented trademark filing/registration and portfolio management, a distinct trademark-specific team, independent corroboration (e.g. rankings for trademark work).

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: patents, trademarks, designs and models, copyright and related rights, know-how, and trade secrets
